questions.question: What is the maximum value of a gift an employee may accept from one source per year?

answer_old.text: Employees may accept gifts with a market value of up to $75 from a single source in a calendar year. [POL-2025-006#2.1] Entertainment with an estimated value over $250 per person requires prior approval from the employee's director. [POL-2025-006#2.3]
